_comment: ADMISSIBLE TARGET ENVELOPE (B1 gate). For each verb and window family, the reach region — relative to the presenter's SQUARE window (fractions of window height h, origin = window center) — in which a target's contact point MUST be solvable within tolerance by the v3 authoring library (no UNREACHABLE inside the envelope). A target OUTSIDE the envelope must yield an actionable nearest-feasible fix, never a silent clamp. The envelope is the DESIGN promise the 18 reach/point slots (3 heights x 2 sides) are built to keep; the gate (tools/render-oracle/envelope-gate.mjs) samples it against an actor's measured timelines and fails on any interior UNREACHABLE.

touch._note: reachable band around the window: lateral +/-0.55h from window center, vertical from 0.15h (low) to -0.40h (high, up above center). Covered by the 6 reach-touch slots.

point-at._note: point reaches farther (standoff 1in) but only mid/high: lateral +/-0.7h, vertical -0.40h..0.0h.

press._note: single mid-right press pose: a tight region right-of-center at mid height.

carry._note: grab point reachable band (near/far slots); the drop point is authored, not gated here.

gate.rule: for each (verb, windowFamily, grid point inside region): solveBestEmpirical against the actor's timelines must return a placement with residualIn <= tolIn AND no UNREACHABLE verdict. PASS = 100% of interior grid points solve. A point that fails is reported with its dx/dy and the nearest solvable point (the actionable fix).
gate.note: the v1 action-clip actors (kinetic-joe) are EXPECTED to fail this — they have no reach-at-height poses; that failure baseline is the evidence motivating the v3 library. The gate goes green when the v3 clips are sourced, baked, and oracle-measured.
